name: Rime's Wrath

angles.text: Frost mages study the raw conjuration and shaping of ice magic, making wild minor ice elementals an intriguing yet unruly display of elemental forces.
Shaman seek to understand and commune with elemental spirits, though these hostile ice entities proved beyond peaceful placation and had to be quelled by force.

faq.answer: Rime's Wrath is a task requiring the destruction of minor ice elementals that pose an immediate threat. Because peaceful methods to pacify these agitated spirits were unknown or unavailable, direct force became the only option to maintain safety.

The minor ice elementals grew too volatile and dangerous to leave unchecked. While peaceful pacification would have been preferred, the knowledge to calm them was lacking, leaving destruction as the necessary measure.
faq.q: Why do the minor ice elementals need to be destroyed?

faq.answer: The quest is directed by someone concerned with containment who hoped to placate the spirits peacefully. Lacking the arcane or spiritual knowledge required to pacify them, they instead turned to adventurers to neutralize the threat.
faq.q: Who requests the destruction of the elementals?

faq.answer: The questgiver notes that placating them was beyond their understanding. Elemental spirits can sometimes be balanced or appeased, but without the proper expertise, their aggression left no alternative but combat.
faq.q: Could the elementals have been dealt with peacefully?

aliases: how strong are minor ice elementals
faq.answer: Minor ice elementals are volatile manifestations of elemental frost. Though classified as minor spirits, their ambient cold and aggressive nature make them dangerous to travelers and local inhabitants if left roaming freely.
faq.q: What kind of creatures are minor ice elementals?

faq.answer: Once ten minor ice elementals are defeated, the immediate danger is quelled. The questgiver laments that violence was necessary, acknowledging that leaving them unchecked was simply too risky.
faq.q: What is the outcome of dealing with the elementals?

sections.body: Rime's Wrath involves dealing with a localized surge of minor ice elementals. These spirits of biting frost and cold have become an active danger in the area, necessitating swift intervention before their chill spreads further or harms passersby. Rather than a coordinated assault, the response is a containment measure against wild, hostile elemental manifestations.
sections.title: A Bitter Manifestation

sections.body: While the preferred outcome was to soothe the agitated frost spirits, the knowledge required to placate them was out of reach. With no practical means of pacification available and the spirits growing increasingly perilous, the only remaining choice was to destroy them to protect the surrounding territory.
sections.title: Beyond Placation

summary: Rime's Wrath is a quest focused on quelling a hazardous outbreak of minor ice elementals. Because methods to peacefully soothe the aggressive frost spirits were unknown, eliminating them became necessary to keep the area safe.
